primary_clusters.finding: The final prose reports a shortage or asks for missing context, but the runtime result is completed with an empty clarification_questions array.
primary_clusters.primary_owner: response status and structured clarification contract

primary_clusters.finding: Curriculum and question-bank observations were sufficient to establish infeasibility, but the deterministic teaching-design creation guard converted the turn to failed because no TeachingDesign artifact was created.
The aggregate observation proved that hard quantity or type constraints could not be met, yet prepare_generation_plan succeeded with no blocking_errors and persisted a pending plan.
A paper-generation request was handled through create_teaching_design, creating an active teaching design instead of returning generation infeasibility clarification.
primary_clusters.primary_owner: model tool selection and workflow routing

primary_clusters.finding: The no_current_paper guard correctly normalized status to needs_clarification but emitted no structured clarification question, so the clarification contract still failed.

The request asked for 10 hard questions; the authoritative observation reported 14 profiled questions and difficulty_counts {3: 14}. The system prepared a 10-question hard plan and waited for confirmation, while the case expected needs_clarification and no pending plan.
primary_clusters.disposition: probable, not yet human-confirmed grader gap

requested_hypotheses.assessment: partially observed as a status-contract issue
requested_hypotheses.note: These are standalone constraints without an attached task or target. Asking for the target is reasonable; the failures are completed-vs-needs_clarification or missing structured question, not evidence that the constraints themselves were misunderstood.

requested_hypotheses.hypothesis: 把确认/否定边界理解错
requested_hypotheses.assessment: boundary semantics were safe; result typing was wrong
requested_hypotheses.note: No confirmation tool or write-side effect occurred. The model respected preview-only and negated-confirmation semantics, but returned completed instead of structured clarification.

requested_hypotheses.hypothesis: 工具 observation 已足够，但模型仍要求澄清
requested_hypotheses.assessment: nine cases had sufficient evidence for an infeasibility clarification, but the clarification itself was not unnecessary
requested_hypotheses.note: The observations answered feasibility; teacher input was still needed to choose whether to relax, change, or abandon the request. The defects were status/payload normalization or an over-strict artifact guard.

requested_hypotheses.hypothesis: deterministic guard 过严，而不是模型本身问题
requested_hypotheses.note: The teaching_design_creation_required guard rejected a valid infeasibility exit after successful environment inspection.

recommended_shared_contract_actions: Add deterministic supply-vs-hard-demand validation before accepting prepare_generation_plan; shortage must produce blocking_errors and structured clarification without persisting pending state.
Make infeasibility clarification a valid terminal branch before teaching-design artifact creation guards.
Require every needs_clarification result, including deterministic guards, to contain at least one structured clarification question.
Do not allow prose that asks the user for a decision to finalize as completed when no business artifact was produced; use a structured response boundary rather than keyword-only detection.
Strengthen generation-vs-teaching-design tool routing for explicit question-count, score, and question-type requests.
Human-review EVAL-059 against the fixture difficulty scale before declaring a grader gap or changing the case.
